name: Flowers & Gardens of Japan 1908 - Ella Du Cane (1874-1943) - 50 images
notes: 40 of 50 images reviewed (batches 1-2). Ella Du Cane (1874-1943), English, clear (PD since 2014, death+71 convention) - no nationality complication despite Japanese subject matter. 10 images still outstanding - keep flagged for review until remaining plates are received.
ofNote: Palette signature distinct from the English garden books elsewhere in catalog: soft pastel/cream ground with selective vivid floral color accents. Spans a natural 'Four Seasons of Japan' arc across the 50 plates - cherry/plum blossom (spring), azalea/iris (summer), lotus/hydrangea (summer), scarlet maple (autumn), and wisteria (late spring) - good framing for marketing copy. Several real, identifiable Japanese landmarks recur across the set (Kiyomizu-dera, Kameido Tenjin, Kitano Tenmangu, Matsushima, Atami, Horikiri Shobuen, Kodai-ji, Satake Garden) - landmark and cultivar details are noted on each individual image's own record as it's reviewed, rather than repeated here.
